title: Child safety online, safety by design, and shared responsibility
discussion_signal: The post frames child safety as a shared system responsibility involving age-appropriate access, safety-by-design, platform accountability, digital literacy, parents, educators, and children’s participation. It turns online safety from an individual household choice into a developmental and institutional contract.
linked_research_question: How do platforms, families, regulators, and offline institutions divide responsibility for children’s digital autonomy and safety?
limits: Reported figures require checking against the underlying panel report
The post does not measure implementation or child outcomes
